capabilities: Create or open a daily journal with a timestamped heading
Send a selection, heading section, or whole note to configured platforms
Preview and edit text and image order before publishing
Resolve local vault images and paste clipboard images into sends
Reopen and resend from a log of the last 10 sends
disambiguation: Not a vault-sync tool; despite its name, it publishes journal content to external platforms rather than keeping files in sync.
extras: Manual installation requires downloading main.js, manifest.json, and styles.css from GitHub Releases; the manifest notes the plugin has not been reviewed by Obsidian staff. The README documents platform-specific limits (e.g., Bluesky 300-grapheme posts, Telegram 9 images per message) and credential-security guidance.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to publish note content directly to social and note platforms without a separate backend service or manual copy-paste.

requires.name: destination platform accounts (flomo, Mastodon, Misskey, Bluesky, Weibo, Notion, Threads)
Telegram Bot Token or platform API tokens/webhooks

summary: Journal capture and publishing plugin that sends selections, heading sections, or whole notes to flomo, Telegram, Mastodon, Misskey, Bluesky, Weibo, Notion, and Threads.
